description:
Role Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities 

 Handles sophisticated client requests, adhering to the Solutions Governance Framework.
 Makes appropriate recommendations and works proactively to deliver results.
 Builds positive relationships with internal and external interested parties.
 Takes an innovative and proactive approach to existing solutions, finding opportunities for improvement and modernization.
 Supports interventions for process and functional requirement gathering related to customer workflows.
 Effectively delivers assigned projects.
 Constructs technical and functional specifications based on client requirements.
 Documents clients requirements and developments in required and assigned share-points.
 Participates in presales calls as required.
 Development Responsibilities 
 Participates on solution designs, implementation.
 Uses and follows guidelines, coding standards, design principles, and engineering guidelines .
 Follows recommendations from code reviews and technical design reviews to improve code quality, maintainability, security, performance, and consistency.
 Follows requirements analysis and solution design through development, testing and deployment.
 Finds opportunities to build reusable components, frameworks, patterns, and accelerators that improve delivery efficiency and reduce implementation effort across projects.
 Participate in knowledge transferring in to the Development team.
 Responsibly embrace AI-assisted software development and automation practices to improve development efficiency, quality assurance, documentation, and engineering workflows.
 Works on technical estimations and supports the assessment of feasibility, complexity, risks, and dependencies for new opportunities.
 Follows technical governance by ensuring appropriate documentation, architecture decisions, development standards, and knowledge-transfer artifacts are produced and maintained.
 Qualifications & Experience 
 Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
 Previous experience in consulting services and/or customer-facing technical roles.
 Experience in software development .
 Understanding of software engineering principles, build patterns, development methodologies, and software development lifecycle practices.
 Experience with source control, code review, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, release management, and production support.
 Ability to translate business and client requirements into robust technical designs and implementation specifications.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently handle sophisticated technical challenges.
 Ability to communicate technical concepts efficiently to both technical and non-technical interested parties.
 Experience working with distributed or global teams is desirable.
 Experience with cloud technologies, APIs, integration architectures, messaging technologies, and modern software development frameworks is desirable.
 Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools and their application is desirable.
 Experience in financial markets, financial technology, or LSEG products and solutions is an advantage.
  Delivers the services of the Customer Consulting team, including understanding clients’ business processes, market guidelines, and the products and services offered by LSEG.
 
 Career Stage: 
Senior Associate 
 London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 
 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
 
 LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
 
 Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership , Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
 
 Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
 
 We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
 
 You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
 
 LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
 
 Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject . 
 
 If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.
